headline: Chip rebound lifts US stocks, but breadth remains weak
summary: The S&P 500 edged higher as semiconductor stocks rebounded and volatility eased. Equal-weight stocks lagged and the Dow fell, limiting evidence of a broad recovery.

highlights.title: Chip stocks led the rebound
highlights.text: Semiconductors recovered part of Thursday’s losses. The equal-weight S&P 500 fell 0.38%, pointing to a narrower rebound than the headline index suggested.

highlights.title: Payrolls beat expectations
highlights.text: The report cites 165,000 October payroll gains and 4.1% unemployment. Stronger jobs data and CPI within the forecast window leave material downside risk.

forecast.outlook: Uneven rebound ahead of US CPI
forecast.horizon: 9–11 November US sessions · S&P 500 final close
forecast.method: Original US outlook in section 9. The forecast ID is a Drive archive locator, and the issue timestamp is the verified completed Drive modification time. The report treats these scenarios as levels to monitor, not calibrated odds.
forecast.watch_next: Watch US CPI, Treasury yields, semiconductor closes and VIX. Mean Brier was 0.727 across 13 completed US windows, worse than the 0.667 uniform baseline.

limitations: Curated from the report, not independently verified. Breadth was secondary, sentiment coverage was partial, and end-of-day put/call and fund-flow data were unavailable. After-hours quotes were not used as forecast anchors.
